sections.heading: Section 7
paragraphs: AYUSH stands for Ayurvedic, Yoga & Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha, and Homeopathy. People of India used to practice these traditional forms of medicine for centuries. However, the government of India recognised the importance of this Indian system of medicine in 2014 and established a separate AYUSH Ministry for the promotion and regulation of it. AYUSH license registration is a kind of certification that allows businesses and individuals to legally practice and deal in AYUSH services. The AYUSH ministry has brought a regulatory framework to ensure the quality and safety of AYUSH products and treatments. AYUSH license ensures that the products are in compliance with the standards set by the ministry of AYUSH.
The Ministry of AYUSH provides for various AYUSH licenses. Some of them are mentioned below:

AYUSH Manufacturing Licence: This is issues to the businesses that are involved in manufacturing or selling AYUSH products. In order to get an AYUSH manufacturing license, businesses have to comply with the standards set by the government.

Unani manufacturing Licence: Unani is an ancient system of medicine. A separate AYUSH license registration is required to the businesses dealing in Unani products. Unani medicines are gaining traction across the world.

Siddha manufacturing licence: Siddha is an ancient system of healing the body as a whole, such as body, mind, and spirit. It is composed of several ancient components of healing, like yoga, meditation, diet prescription, and many other things. This type of AYUSH license registration is required for businesses dealing in products and services that are used for Siddha.

AYUSH Loan Licence: It is a license issued to the third party dealing in AYUSH manufacturing products. Businesses that don’t have their own manufacturing set up and use the products of any other licensed manufacturer, then in that case also, they require the AYUSH license registration known as the AYUSH loan license.

The government fees for AYUSH licenses depend on the type of the license. You can visit the official website of the ministry of AYUSH to get the latest information about the fee structure for different kinds of licenses. For example, AYUSH manufacturing license fees in India is Rs 2,000.
There are many benefits of AYUSH license.
AYUSH license grants legal permission to the businesses dealing in manufacturing and selling AYUSH products in compliance with the guidelines and standards set by the concerned legal authority.
Increased Credibility
AYUSH license registration helps in boosting the reliability of AYUSH products of the manufacturers, building consumer trust, and increasing the market size of the business.
International Market Access

After acquiring the AYUSH license, businesses get the legal authority to export their products to international markets. It will give a recognition to the ancient Indian system of medicine at the international level.
AYUSH license registration establishes a faith in the consumers about the products. It assures the customers about the quality and safety of the products.

The Government provides various kinds of tax exemption benefits to the businesses with AYUSH manufacturing license. They will enjoy many benefits, such as tax benefits, and the benefits provided by the government through various schemes.
